name: Attentive
purpose: Tracks visits and shows SMS sign-up forms.

cookies.name: _attn_
cookies.purpose: Stores visitor identity and browsing details.

cookies.name: __attentive_id
cookies.purpose: Identifies visitors and controls sign-up form display.

cookies.name: __attentive_dv
cookies.purpose: Limits checks for deleted visitor identifiers.

cookies.name: __attentive_ss_referrer
cookies.purpose: Remembers the referrer for sign-up form display.

cookies.name: __attentive_pv
cookies.purpose: Counts session page views for sign-up form display.

cookies.name: __attentive_cco
cookies.purpose: Records when the visitor identifier should be replaced.

cookies.name: attntv_mstore_*
cookies.purpose: Links checkout contact details to visitor events.

cookies.name: __attentive_ceid
cookies.purpose: Identifies the Attentive account across checkout subdomains.

cookies.name: __attentive_domain
cookies.purpose: Identifies the Attentive region across checkout subdomains.
